description: This file defines the LogExtent class and its internal enumerator, which manage and iterate over log segments stored in an ArcBuffer, including reading variable-length entries and their payloads.

classes.name: LogExtent
classes.description: Represents a sealed, immutable log segment backed by an ArcBuffer, providing enumeration over its entries.

classes.name: LogExtent.Entry
classes.description: A record struct representing a log entry with a StreamId and Payload.

classes.name: LogExtent.EntryEnumerator
classes.description: An internal enumerator for iterating over entries within a LogExtent.

methods.name: LogExtent()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty buffer.

methods.name: Entries
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over the entries in the log segment.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new EntryEnumerator for a given LogExtent.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the enumerator to the next entry, reading the entry length and payload.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the enumerator to its initial state.
